description: This file defines a function named 'map_equal' that compares two CMake maps for equality, considering nested structures and respecting cycles. It checks the length, keys, and values of the maps recursively, handling lists and nested maps appropriately to determine if the maps are equal.

methods.name: map_equal
methods.description: Recursively compares two maps or values (lists or strings) for equality, handling nested maps, lists, and cycles to determine overall equality.
